Nimisha Agarwal Email: nimisha.aug06@gmail.com | Mobile: +91 9711992235 | Hyderabad, Telangana 500050.

Profile Summary: ➢ Banking and Operations professional with 20+ years of experience in Client Onboarding, KYC/AML Due Diligence, Corporate Banking Operations, Account Maintenance, Regulatory Compliance, and Stakeholder Management. Experienced in managing corporate client relationships, coordinating with internal and external banking partners, supporting client lifecycle management, and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements. Proven ability to manage complex onboarding projects, resolve operational issues, improve processes, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve strategic business objectives. Involved in various banking applications end to end rollouts: GEMS (Global Enquiry Management System) & RRMS (Regulatory

➢ ➢ Request Monitoring System) from implementation till handover which includes workshops for operation teams

across India.

➢ Exposure in the core banking domains area like Deposits, Disbursement, Payments & Collections. ➢ Proven skills in managing some top clients in the industry, managing industries top Global Corporate and leading financial

Institutions as a dedicated one point of contact.

➢ Successfully completed PMP training from PMI affiliated trainer. ➢ Experienced in developing, mentoring, and leading successful workforce teams.

Specialties: Stakeholder Management Team Management (10 - 20+ Size) Business Relationship Management Operations Management. Hybrid Project Management

Banking Domain: Customer Services Management Client Onboarding & Management CDD/EDD, KYC & AML Checks, Legal and Compliance, Core Banking Payment Products Quality Assurance

Strength: Strong verbal & written communication Flexible & Collaborative Approach Conflict Management Understand & define right priorities. Strong decision-making skills.

Employment History: ➢ Assistant Vice President, Apex Fund Services LLP (Feb 2023 – Oct 2025) ➢ Associate Manager with Standard Chartered Bank, Gurgaon (Apr 2018 – Feb 2023) ➢ Senior Officer with Standard Chartered Bank, Gurgaon (Apr 2013 – Mar 2018) ➢ Officer with Standard Chartered Bank, Gurgaon (July 2007- March 2013) ➢

Junior Officer Trainee with Standard Chartered Bank, Gurgaon (Oct 2005 – June 2007)

Educational Qualifications: ➢ Master’s in business administration: Institute of Management & Technology, CDL Ghaziabad (Jan 2005 -Dec 2008) ➢ Bachelor of Commerce: Maitreyi College, Delhi University (May 2002 - Jun 2005)

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

Client Services Manager, Corporate & Business Services, India

➢ Managed end-to-end onboarding of domestic and international corporate clients, ensuring timely completion of KYC, AML,

CDD and EDD requirements.

➢ Coordinated with banking partners, legal teams, compliance, auditors and internal stakeholders to complete onboarding and

periodic KYC reviews.

➢ Supported client lifecycle activities including account opening, updating Customer Information, client maintenance, signatory

updates and regulatory documentation.

➢ Performed customer due diligence by reviewing ownership structures, constitutional documents, FATCA, CRS and regulatory

requirements.

➢ Ensured timely completion of periodic KYC refreshes and remediation activities while maintaining regulatory compliance. Investigated sanctions, adverse media and AML alerts and coordinated resolution with Compliance teams. ➢ ➢ Managed documentation for banking facilities and ensured completeness of legal and security documentation. ➢ Escalated onboarding and operational issues proactively while recommending process improvements to enhance efficiency

and service quality.

Client On-Boarding & Client Lifecyle Management.

➢ Client On-boarding and CLM involves managing daily corporate client portfolios and executing new client onboarding, including

KYC review and understanding ownership structures for both international and local corporates.

➢ Responsible for processing Client Account Maintenance (e.g., updating customer information, managing changes in ownership, signatory, account details and closure of accounts) in relevant systems, ensuring regulatory compliance for FATCA, CRS, FM account opening, etc.

➢ Skilled in CDD/EDD/transaction monitoring, performing periodic AML reviews, and performing and investigating adverse

➢

media, pep screening or sanctions. involved in CLM transformation initiatives where we focused on improving the end-to-end client onboarding and KYC lifecycle. This included redesigning processes, implementing technology solutions, standardizing workflows across regions, improving data quality, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. The objective was to enhance the client experience, reduce processing time, and strengthen operational efficiency and risk management."

➢ Coordinate with auditors, portfolio managers, credit analysts, and legal teams to sanction proposals and ensure proper

documentation for channel partners.

➢ Oversee stock and fixed assets insurance, conduct valuations and inspections for P&M, L&B, stocks, and factories. ➢ Review business credit applications. ➢ Prepare banking facility letters, contracts, and security documents. ➢ Verify customer-executed documents and report discrepancies to the business team. ➢ ➢ Ensure documents comply with approval matrix and deferral authority under credit policy. ➢ Maintain accurate lodgment and withdrawal records of securing documents in CMS and keep all CMS activities updated.

Issue security compliance certificates for perfected documents.

Project Management Office

➢ Collaborate with project managers, team members, technical teams, and stakeholders to monitor, develop, and implement

project plans and associated content. ➢ Track project milestones and deliverables. ➢ ➢ Provide regular updates to management and project sponsors, organize periodic reviews, and prepare documentation to

Implement and monitor key milestones and relevant KPIs to assess project progress.

➢

communicate progress. Identify and address issues and conflicts within the program, projects, project management community, and with stakeholders as necessary.

➢ Resolve issues at the project or line level, escalating unresolved matters as appropriate. ➢ Promote the adoption of agile methodology across teams. ➢ Develop the best practices and tools for project execution and management. ➢ Ensure the use of standards and practices across all projects.

Client Service Group

➢ Led the North CSG team, overseeing performance, service levels, and ensuring full compliance with TAT for client queries

across all channels.

➢ Managed internal and external stakeholders; coordinated with clients, Relationship Managers, and Transaction Banking Sales

to align expectations and drive operational improvements.

➢ Served as Premier Service Manager at Standard Chartered Bank, managing major corporate accounts. ➢ Monitored unit risks and processes, conducted monthly Key Control Standard checks, and reported exceptions. ➢ Delivered online solutions for daily transaction banking activities and resolved client queries on channels, trade, and cash

management.

➢ Managed top global corporate and financial institution clients as their dedicated contact. ➢ Promoted a client-centric culture, handled escalations, managed workflow, and enhanced client experience. ➢ Trained and developed new team members.

Core Banking Payment & Operations

➢ Overseeing all requests and inquiries related to the issuance of Demand Drafts (DDs), Pay Orders (POs), ICFTs, stop payments,

transfers, clearing activities, and other associated services.

➢ Handling requests and inquiries for both local and foreign currency outward and inward telegraphic transfers. ➢ Managing requests and inquiries related to RTGS, electronic payments, and similar transactions. ➢ Supervising processes for account opening, signature verification referrals, and signature updates for corporate accounts. ➢ Addressing general inquiries and calls pertaining to all banking transactions, including remittances, EFT, stop payments, cash deliveries, collections, pick-ups, and trade-related matters. Maintaining daily and weekly tracking of pending issues and monitoring the aging of unresolved cases.

➢ Collaborating with internal stakeholders to address service requirements, inquiries, and instructions.

Key Achievements/Awards/Recognitions ➢ Service Excellence Awards. ➢ Multiple ‘Manager Choice’ Awards for contribution in delivering quality Services. ➢ Star Award for maintaining the highest standard of Customer Satisfaction and Retention.

My Strengths: ➢ My managerial skills, ability to work under pressure & handle complex issues independently enable me to bring confidence

in my team.

➢ Stakeholders Management & Collaborative approach. ➢ Positive frame of mind, attitude to learn and openness to accept challenges make me a competitive person. ➢ Committed & hard-working team player with flexible approach and ability to take initiative whenever required. ➢ Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
